title: Which pieces are the same kind of thing

ask.text: Sort them into weld stacks.

hints.text: A load standing on one pan. It settles inward-out.
Same socket, same power, same stack. Everything else is a different kind.
3x is in the first stack. Three stacks come out of this in the end.

worldFraming.text: Kinds. A length and a weight will not stand together and the socket does not argue about it.
